name: RAS related 2

function.text: RRAS2 encodes ras-related protein R-Ras2. Annotated molecular activities include GTPase activity and G protein activity. It participates in Ras protein signal transduction and osteoblast differentiation.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to Noonan syndrome (autosomal dominant); noonan syndrome 12 (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Somatic sequence alterations have cohort-level candidate-driver evidence in Endometrial Carcinoma. This gene-level statistical evidence requires allele-specific review and does not establish the effect of every variant.
